title: Observability, Telemetry, Crash Reporting & Privacy-Safe Evidence
objective: Connect MIB-16 diagnostics to deployed beta operation: crash/error capture, correlation identifiers, product health/performance telemetry, automatic bug bundles, log redaction, evidence consent, privacy classifications and diagnostic export.
acceptance: Declared failures can be traced from user-visible incident to actionable privacy-safe evidence without exposing hidden/private cross-context data.
boundaries: BRP-01..04 and SMB-01..16 remain sealed predecessor authority.
BRP-05 is selected_not_started only and has no implementation authority until governed start.
MIB-16 remains diagnostics/provenance/search engineering authority; BRP-05 operationalizes privacy-safe beta evidence without creating parallel diagnostic truth.
MIB-17/SMB-14 family-safety/security/privacy boundaries remain sealed and cross-context private data may not enter telemetry or bug bundles.
Tester distribution, public beta/community activation, release, paid providers, commerce and BRP-06+ remain unauthorized.
BRP must complete through BRP-11 BETA_READY before normal SMB-17 activation.
next_action: BRP-05 is completed_verified. BRP-06 — Data Durability, Backup, Restore, Migration & Rollback — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
